title: PlanMakerChosenData
description: data of plan.maker_chosen (ADR-0050, MK-06): at Start, where the person chose to make one deliverable whose format offers a choice in config/makers.yaml; one event per such deliverable, in brief order, in the same save as the budget grant. The actor is the person and the target the world. A choice authorises nothing: a partner's action stays T3 behind its own card (MK-07). suggested is the option code suggested (MK-04), or null when it suggested none, so the Trace shows whether the person followed it.

deliverable.description: 0-based position of the deliverable in the brief (a brief has at most 10).

title.description: The deliverable's title in the brief.

label.description: The chosen option's display name as the start plan showed it, e.g. Tilo, Lovable or Canva.
